questions.question: Which chart type is best for showing parts of a whole?
questions.explanation: Pie charts display proportions of a whole as slices of a circle.

questions.question: What type of plot shows the relationship between two continuous variables?
questions.explanation: Scatter plots display individual data points to reveal correlations between variables.

questions.question: Which visualization shows the distribution of data across quartiles?
questions.explanation: Box plots display median, quartiles, and potential outliers in a dataset.

questions.question: What is the most popular Python library for data visualization?
questions.explanation: Matplotlib is the foundational plotting library in Python for creating static visualizations.

questions.question: Which chart type is best for showing trends over time?
questions.explanation: Line charts connect data points to show changes and trends over continuous intervals.

questions.question: What visualization displays the correlation between multiple variables as colored cells?
questions.explanation: Heatmaps use color intensity to represent values in a matrix format.

questions.question: Which library builds on Matplotlib with a higher-level interface?
questions.explanation: Seaborn provides attractive statistical graphics with simpler syntax than Matplotlib.

questions.question: What type of chart compares values across categories using rectangular bars?
questions.explanation: Bar charts use horizontal or vertical bars to compare categorical data.

questions.question: Which visualization combines box plot and kernel density information?
questions.explanation: Violin plots show the distribution shape along with quartile information.

questions.question: What library is used for creating interactive web-based visualizations?
questions.explanation: Plotly creates interactive, publication-quality graphs that work in web browsers.

questions.question: Which chart is best for showing the frequency distribution of a continuous variable?
questions.explanation: A histogram bins continuous values and shows their frequency.

questions.question: Which Matplotlib function adds a title to a plot?
questions.explanation: plt.title sets the text displayed above the axes.

questions.question: Which chart displays hierarchical data as concentric rings?
questions.explanation: Sunburst charts nest hierarchy levels as rings radiating outward.

questions.question: Which seaborn function draws a scatter plot with a fitted regression line?
questions.explanation: regplot overlays a regression fit on a scatter plot.

questions.question: Which chart shows how sequential positive and negative values build a final total?
questions.explanation: Waterfall charts display cumulative contributions between an initial and final value.

questions.question: What do error bars on a chart typically represent?
questions.explanation: Error bars show the spread or uncertainty around a measured value.

questions.question: Which chart compares part-to-whole relationships across several categories?
questions.explanation: Stacked bars show totals and their component shares per category.

questions.question: What does a word cloud visualize?
questions.explanation: Word clouds size each term by how often it appears in text.

questions.question: Which Matplotlib function saves a figure to a file?
questions.explanation: plt.savefig writes the current figure to disk.

questions.question: Which visualization creates a matrix of scatter plots for every pair of variables?
questions.explanation: A pair plot shows all pairwise relationships in a grid.

questions.question: Which seaborn function combines a scatter plot with marginal histograms?
questions.explanation: jointplot draws the bivariate relationship plus univariate margins.

questions.question: Which chart displays open, high, low, and close values for financial data?
questions.explanation: Candlestick charts encode OHLC prices per time period.

questions.question: Which R library implements the Grammar of Graphics for plotting?
questions.explanation: ggplot2 composes plots from layered grammar-of-graphics elements.

questions.question: What is the technique of repeating the same chart across subsets of data called?
questions.explanation: Faceting produces small multiples, one panel per data subset.

questions.question: Which chart fills the area between a line and the axis to emphasize magnitude over time?
questions.explanation: Area charts shade below the line to stress cumulative magnitude.

questions.question: Which plot displays three-dimensional data as contour lines on two dimensions?
questions.explanation: Contour plots trace equal-value lines to render a third dimension in 2D.
